title: Golden Brownie French Halwa
description: A rich French dessert made with vegan golden brownie and halwa, a classic Indian treat. This indulgent sweet delight combines two worlds of flavors and textures.

ingredients.name: Halwa
ingredients.notes: Indian-style dessert made from wheat flour, ghee, and sugar

ingredients.name: Vegan Milk
ingredients.notes: such as almond or soy milk

instructions: Grease a 9-inch (23cm) round dish with coconut oil.
Crush the golden brownie into small pieces and place in a large mixing bowl.
Add the halwa, vegan milk, and vegan chocolate chips to the bowl with the crushed brownie.
Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Pour the mixture into the prepared dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly gooey.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh fruit or whipped cream if desired.
